message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes. All of them are located in the city proper (not in the suburbs) and have good reviews for their vegetarian options. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|------------------------| | **Siam Square** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | • Pad Thai (vegetarian version)
• Tofu Massaman Curry
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls
• Green Curry with tofu | | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | • Vegetarian Pad See Ew
• Tofu Pad Krapow
• Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup
• Veggie Spring Rolls | | **Thai Orchid** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | • Vegetarian Pad Thai
• Tofu Green Curry
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls
• Veggie Stir‑Fry with mixed vegetables | | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | • Vegetarian Pad Thai
• Tofu Massaman Curry
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls
• Veggie Stir‑Fry | | **Siam Square** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | • Pad Thai (vegetarian version)
• Tofu Massaman Curry
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls
• Green Curry with tofu | > **Note:** All of these restaurants are located on W 18th Street in the West Loop, which is a convenient area for most Chicago residents. They all offer a range of vegetarian dishes, and many of them also have vegan options if you’re looking for plant‑only meals. If you’d like to check availability for a specific date or want to make a reservation, let me know the date and time, and I can help you look up the reservation options.
